name: rmz-budgeting-tools
description: A TypeScript monorepo for spending, market data, and Google Sheets budgeting tools

scripts.install:packages: npm ci --prefix packages/google-sheets && npm ci --prefix packages/market-data && npm ci --prefix packages/revolut-spending
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/google-sheets && npm run build --prefix packages/market-data && npm run build --prefix packages/revolut-spending
scripts.test:packages: npm test --prefix packages/google-sheets && npm test --prefix packages/market-data && npm test --prefix packages/revolut-spending
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:requirements
